name: Golden Gate Bridge
description: Original CC0 procedural Golden Gate Bridge at true metre scale: 1937 suspension composition with requested modern paint, lights and median. Final finish correction reduces paint washout and concrete repetition. 299,788 triangles, 8 materials, 167 estimated primitive draws.
